import java.util.Arrays;

        while (y > 0) {
            if ((y & 1) == 1) ans = (ans * now) % p;

                    }
                }
            }
        } else {
            for (int i = 1; i < len; i <<= 1) {
                for (int j = 0; j < len; j += (i << 1)) {
                    for (int k = j; k < i + j; k++) {
                        T[i + k] += T[k];

        for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
            now[i] = (int) (T[i] % p);

    static void addTo(long[][] arr, int row, int col, long val) {

        int n = sc.nextInt();
